effect_description_eng: [When Digivolving] 1 of your opponent's Digimon can't unsuspend until the end of their turn. If [Togemon] or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] This Digimon gets +1000 DP for each of your opponent's suspended Digimon.
